query_text: Where can I find the latest news about the stock market?

action.query: official stock market news SEC investor.gov market news Reuters markets Bloomberg markets CNBC markets
queries: official stock market news SEC investor.gov market news Reuters markets Bloomberg markets CNBC markets

content.text:
Good places to find **latest stock market news**:

- **Reuters Markets** — fast, reliable market-moving headlines and global coverage.
- **Bloomberg Markets** — strong professional-grade coverage, though much is paywalled. ([bloomberg.com](https://www.bloomberg.com/markets?utm_source=openai))
- **CNBC Markets** — accessible real-time market news, interviews, and TV clips.
- **Yahoo Finance** — good free hub for quotes, watchlists, earnings, charts, and aggregated news. ([finance.yahoo.com](https://finance.yahoo.com/?utm_source=openai))
- **MarketWatch** — investor-friendly market summaries, sector moves, and economic calendar coverage.
- **Wall Street Journal Markets** — strong analysis, often paywalled.
- **Nasdaq Newsroom / Nasdaq.com** — useful for exchange-related news, IPOs, listings, and market insights. ([nasdaq.com](https://www.nasdaq.com/newsroom/?utm_source=openai))
- **SEC.gov Newsroom** — best for official U.S. regulatory announcements, enforcement actions, and filings-related news. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/newsroom?utm_source=openai))

For **real-time prices**, use Yahoo Finance, Nasdaq, your brokerage app, TradingView, or Bloomberg. For **official company news**, check SEC filings, company investor-relations pages, and press releases.
